lines.en: My long wings carry me over the wetland.
My wingtips nearly touch the water.
I thread my way between the reeds.
A gust pushes me off course.
I follow the sunlight eastward.
I pause in mid-air, then go on.
The patterns on my wings catch the light.
I fly low, hunting for flowers.

lines.zh: 每扇一下翅，就升高一点
lines.en: Each beat lifts me a little higher.
I circle that clump of grass.
My shadow wavers on the water.

lines.zh: 我飞过一片开花的浅滩
lines.en: I cross a shallows full of blossoms.
My wings tire, so I glide a while.
I clear the tips of the leaves.
The wetland wind carries moisture.
I head for that yellow flower.

lines.zh: 我落在湿地的芦苇尖上。
lines.en: I settle on a reed tip in the wetland.
My wings open and close slowly.
Sunlight lies across my wings.
I take a sip of nectar.

lines.zh: 我的翅面在阳光下透亮。
lines.en: My wing panels glow in the sunlight.
I warm myself in the sun.
A drop of water falls from the leaf tip.
I turn my body slowly.
The wind stops, and so do I.
My day is still long.
I'm waiting for the next gust.
This wetland is very quiet.
You stand, and your shadow falls on me.
I settle on the grass beside your hand.
You don't chase, so I don't fly.
I tilt my wings and look at you.
You carry no scent of flowers.
Startled, I rise a little higher.
I circle back and land where I was.
Don't move your finger.
I see now that you're alive.

lines.zh: 这么大的东西，我只看看
lines.en: Something so large — I'll only look.
I'm knocked askew.
A corner of my wing is gone.
I fall to the grass and can't move.
My wings are trembling.
I try to fly, and can't.
I can't bear that much weight.
I fold myself up.
Scale dust falls all around.
One vein in my wing has broken.
I crawl slowly forward.
That flower's scent is strong.
Is that a dandelion?

lines.zh: 蒲公英的黄，我隔着叶就看见。
lines.en: I spot the dandelion's yellow through the leaves.
Put it down and I'll come.
I settle on the petals.
This nectar is sweet.
More pollen on my legs now.
The one in your hand is fading.
I prefer the ones still on the stem.
Set another one down.
One tilt of my wings and I'm clear.
You nearly brushed my wing.
The wind pushed me into you.
I settle back on a leaf and steady.

lines.zh: 这么近，我看清了你的纹路
lines.en: This close, I see the grain of you.
I veer around your fingers.
A little scale dust came off my wing.
Your movements are too quick.
I move to the far side of the flowers.
Let's try that again.
Your wings are longer than mine.
We settle on the same flower.
I circle you twice in the air.
Wing pattern answers wing pattern.
You go east, and I go east.
There's flying room enough here.
The underside of a leaf will do for eggs.
We live only this one season.
Don't stray far; the wind will rise.
Stay with me. Don't get left behind.
I take a little from the flower.
The pollen comes away on its own.
I brush it with a foreleg.

lines.zh: 我把花粉粒按在另一朵上。
lines.en: I press the pollen grain onto another bloom.
I leave it on another bloom.
That sip will hold me a while.
Nectar clings to my mouthparts.

lines.zh: 我身上沾的金粉掉了一些。
lines.en: Some of the golden dust on me falls away.
Too heavy to carry off.
I'll leave the pollen for the next flower.
A flower is moving up ahead.
I rise a little for a better look.
The color over there is bright.
Something's behind that leaf.
I glide that way.
The wind shakes it hard.
I stop, and it stops moving.
It might be only wind.
I'll get a little closer to see.
I change direction.

lines.zh: 湿地的蒲公英，够我飞一天。
lines.en: Wetland dandelions fuel a whole day.
It hasn't moved from there.
Long wings along the lee — closing in.
My wingbeats are very soft.
I hover, watching.
Its shape isn't quite a flower.
Hesitated, then came closer.
I decide to fly nearer.
The wind pushes me back.
I'll try again from another angle.
I beat my wings once.

lines.zh: 湿地的长翅，飞得比风慢。
lines.en: Wetland longwings fly slower than wind.
All I can do is bump into it.
Scale dust scatters.
It seems to tickle it.
I pull back, wings still quivering.
What strength I have is slight.
I circle behind it.
Another bump won't help.
I fly off.
I struggle out of the chrysalis.
My wings are still soft, spread out.
I wait for them to harden.

lines.zh: 第一次扇翅，我感觉到了风
lines.en: My first wingbeat — I feel the wind.
The wetland shines below me.
I don't know which way to fly.
The sun dries my wings.
One of my kind passes by.
I follow its direction.
There's a scent of flowers in the air.
One touch of fire curls my wings.

lines.zh: 我从高处飘落，摔在草上
lines.en: I drift down from a height and hit the grass.
Water plasters my wings.
The blast flings me far.
Something thin pierced my wing.
A force pins my wings down.
No flowers to find; I grow lighter and weaker.
In the lightning flash my sight blurs.
I fall and fall; my wings are useless.
